title: Frequency study
description: Individual letters travel along a controllable sine wave.
useCase: Build an expressive typographic mark whose motion suggests sound or rhythm.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Acid lime-green field with heavy royal-blue sans capitals tilted along a curve over five faint staff lines, plus a range slider with monospace label.
motion: Dragging the phase slider moves each letter along a sine wave, up to 32 px vertically and 11° of tilt with per-letter offsets, eased over 120 ms.
adapt: Each letter's `translateY` and `rotate` come from `Math.sin` and `Math.cos` of `i * 0.62 + phase / 12` (amplitudes 32 px and 11°); the `.wave span` transition eases it. Replace the split word, and drive `phase` from audio, scroll or time if needed.
